bound_policy: Driver initializes bound to zero; only defined by native contract on failure.

fortran.driver:
program reference
implicit none
integer which,status
real(8) p,q,s,mean,bound
read(*,*) which,p,q,s,mean
bound=0
call cdfpoi(which,p,q,s,mean,status,bound)
write(*,'(I5,5ES26.17E3)') status,p,q,s,mean,bound
end program reference
